text: 你早晨醒来，庆幸自己总算休息了一晚。你从床上起身，打量着房间简朴的陈设：一只小巧而质量低劣的五斗柜，以及塞在角落里、狭窄又积满灰尘的写字桌。桌上放着一盘鸡蛋和吐司，显然是旅馆老板为你准备的。墙壁朴素无饰，只有一扇窗户朝向湖面。不过，此刻窗外的景色被浓得惊人的雾气挡住了，那雾泛着淡绿色。你的视线完全被遮蔽，无法看透那团诡异的绿雾。
你还注意到自己的随身物品摆在房间各处，和昨晚离开时一模一样。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 9
text: You wake in the morning, grateful for the rest. You rise from your bed and take in the modest surroundings that make up your room. The furnishings are sparse; a small poor-quality dresser and a cramped and dusty writing desk tucked in the corner. Sitting atop the desk is a plate of eggs and toast, apparently set out for you by the hotel’s owner. The walls are plain and unadorned, save for a single window that faces toward the lake. However, this view is currently blocked by the incredibly thick fog, which has taken on a pale green hue. Your vision is obscured entirely, and you cannot see into the depths of that outlandish green mist.
You also notice your personal belongings placed around the room, exactly as you left them the night before.
